issues.description: setIsMounted is not defined — ReferenceError thrown repeatedly (14+ times). This causes hydration failure and a full page reload via Fast Refresh.
issues.element: Particle animation / mount guard in step-1 page
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-1/page.tsx, setIsMounted is referenced (e.g. in useEffect) but the useState declaration `const [isMounted, setIsMounted] = useState(false)` is either missing or the destructuring is wrong (e.g. only `isMounted` was destructured without `setIsMounted`).

issues.description: Hydration mismatch: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' — happens because particle positions or time-based values are generated during server render with different values than client render.
issues.element: Gold particle animation canvas / particle text nodes
issues.root_cause: Particle coordinates or counts are computed with Math.random() or Date.now() at module/render level rather than inside a useEffect or behind an isMounted guard, causing server HTML to differ from client HTML.

fixes.reason: setIsMounted was not destructured from useState, causing the ReferenceError 'setIsMounted is not defined' on every render.
Particles must only be generated client-side after mount to prevent hydration mismatch from Math.random() producing different values on server vs client.
Ensures setIsMounted(true) is called after mount — this is likely already present but needs to be confirmed correct; combined with fix #1 this resolves the ReferenceError and hydration error.
